title: Drift Vision Frames Pro 5
alludes_to: Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses (Gen 3) — camera glasses
description: Built as the Signature version of Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses (Gen 3) — camera glasses, the Drift Vision Frames Pro 5 reproduces its operational facts in original expression — nine-hour battery with six microphones, from $449. Its 2026 release positioned it for everyday wearers.
